a.lede: A small number of early adopters of the much-hyped new foldable phone from Apple have complained of screens cracking.
a.title: Uh-oh, it sounds like the iPhone Duo keeps cracking and users aren’t happy about it

b.lede: Apple has just released iOS 27.2, bringing Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. The software update also includes an "Edge Light" feature for the iPhone Duo that's intended to illuminate your face during video calls.
